identity.individuality_rule: Two Twiglet of the same species are not required to share personality, temperament, affection style, social behavior, preferences, fears, habits, or reactions.

personality.behavior_rule: Personality rolls change how this individual Twiglet expresses an intent. They do not change the underlying biological need.

preference_discovery.discovery_rule: Repeated experiences gradually establish the individual Twiglet's preferences rather than assigning universal species favorites.

care_willingness.rule: High bond can increase trust and willingness, but does not force an individual Twiglet to become cheerful, social, affectionate, energetic, or obedient.

move_catalog.description: Existing Earth physical basic attack; preserve approved ATK/elemental formula. Level 1 starting action, not a new species unlock.
Old generic frontend level 5 registry description retained solely as a compatibility reference; no Twiglet level 5 natural species unlock is approved.
Retain approved MAGI healing formula and 1 MP cost.

skills.level_milestones_reference: skill_unlocks_by_level is the only per-level move-unlock table. Level 2 lists candidates, not automatically learned moves.

hatchling_move_design_draft.notes: Four proposed Earth-only, hatchling-scale Level 2 natural species candidates. No implementation, numerical effects, or learned/equipped state is approved. Preserve existing basic-strike and mend engine behavior. Display names and descriptions, never role labels; one confirmed choice only. Maximum MP = (base Mana + allocated Mana + applicable passive Mana) * 3. MAGI controls magical power; special skills require approved MP costs; physical basic attacks are free. Proposed numeric effects and costs remain null.

player_skill_decisions.replacement_semantics: Future approved milestones only: preserve existing animation timing; show four eligible skill names/descriptions, never role labels; select and confirm one. Validate ownership, eligibility and retry identity to prevent duplicate learning/rewards. Replacement must respect authoritative learned capacity, explicitly confirm the old skill and commit atomically. Four local equipped slots do not establish learned capacity. Cancel/failure preserves old skills; unselected skills are not learned. No UI or persistence activated.
